summary: Frontend-only verification of the Trust Viewer + WYSIWYG editor flow. Drove the full admin journey via Playwright: admin login -> /admin -> open existing case -> TrustSectionsEditor -> add/edit article -> RTE formatting (Bold, Italic, Bulleted list, Numbered list, Link) -> inline Preview toggle -> Duplicate article -> Remove -> Save -> reload persistence -> 'Preview as Client' -> Two-Panel viewer (watermark, right-click block, mobile stack). 13/14 critical scenarios PASS. ONE SPEC GAP: the RichTextEditor toolbar does NOT include an Underline button (spec asked for Bold/Italic/Underline/lists/link). The component has Bold, Italic, Paragraph, H3 (Subheading), Quote, UL, OL, Link, Undo, Redo only. Duplicate article works correctly: title gets ' (copy)' suffix, trust_html & explainer_html clone exactly, edits to the duplicate do NOT mutate the original, remove leaves siblings intact. Save shows 'Saved — N articles' toast and persists across reload. Preview-as-Client opens new tab to /admin/cases/{id}/trust-viewer-preview with admin-preview-banner + trust-viewer-two-panel + watermark + right-click prevention. Mobile (414x900) collapses to single column. Pricing visibility: NO $997 or $297 labels found at /start-new (one '997' substring match was a false positive from a generated email address 'support+client1776543997@igcfirm.com', not a price). Backend testing skipped per request.

ui_bugs.issue: Underline toolbar button is MISSING. Spec/review_request explicitly asked for 'Bold, Italic, Underline, bullet list, numbered list, link' but the component only exposes Bold, Italic, Paragraph, Subheading (H3), Quote, Bulleted list, Numbered list, Link, Undo, Redo. Add an Underline button using exec('underline').

Nested <button> inside <button> causes React hydration warnings in the console on the admin dashboard. diagnostics-refresh-btn (a real <button>) is rendered inside diagnostics-toggle-btn (also a <button>). Refactor the outer toggle to a div with role='button' or move the refresh control outside the toggle.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Add an Underline button to RichTextEditor.jsx toolbar (use document.execCommand('underline')) and a corresponding data-testid `${testId}-underline` to match the spec.
(LOW) Fix nested <button> inside <button> in DiagnosticsPanel.jsx — switch outer toggle to a non-button element to clear React hydration console warnings on /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: TrustSectionsEditor.jsx is solid: deep-copy on duplicate (spreads primitive strings, not refs) so duplicate is correctly independent of source. Verified by mutating duplicate title and confirming source title unchanged.
RichTextEditor.jsx uses document.execCommand which is deprecated by W3C but still works in all current browsers; for long-term resilience consider Tiptap/Slate. Underline missing (see action items).

TrustViewerTwoPanel.jsx watermark uses inline SVG background-image with text 'DRAFT — NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION' — verified present via getComputedStyle. Right-click prevented via document-level contextmenu handler — verified e.defaultPrevented === true.
AdminTrustViewerPreview.jsx correctly reuses TrustViewerTwoPanel so admin sees identical behavior to client. Banner is visually distinct (amber) so admins won't confuse it with live client view.

useEffect in TrustSectionsEditor that hydrates from initialSections is correct — depends on [initialSections] only and uses initialSections.length conditional. The previously removed invalid eslint-disable comment fix is confirmed; component compiles and runs.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (13/14 scenarios fully pass; Underline button is the only missing feature)

rca of the issue: Underline missing: RichTextEditor.jsx defines toolbar buttons inline; the dev simply omitted the Underline Btn. Trivial 2-line fix — add `<Btn onClick={() => exec('underline')} label='Underline'><Underline className='h-3.5 w-3.5'/></Btn>` and import Underline from lucide-react.
